source: Finance Department notification NO.FD.SR-III-4-244/2023(B), Lahore, 2 December 2024, amending the Punjab Civil Services Pension Rules with immediate effect. Signed Mujahid Sherdil, Finance Secretary.
_note_on_types: Every numeric value in this file is a STRING, deliberately.
json.load turns a JSON number into a Python float, and FMT-02 forbids float money.
A commutation factor of 12.3719 read as a float and multiplied by a gross pension is
exactly the class of silent precision loss the rule exists to prevent, so the loader
refuses floats and converts these strings with Decimal instead.
_what_changed_from_PB-2026.02: This pack exists because the December 2024 amendment reaches almost every figure the
engine computes, and the pack in the repository predated it. Each change below is a
different pension, not a different wording:
1. THE BASE. Rule 4.4(4) was substituted outright. The pension base is no longer the
last drawn six-component reckonable pay; it is the average of BASIC PAY INCLUDING
PERSONAL PAY over the last three years, taken from 1 July of each. Two changes at
once: an average rather than a last-drawn figure, and two components rather than six.
This resolves BLOCKING-01, and in a third way that neither prior reading anticipated.
2. COMMUTATION. Rule 8.1: 'one half' becomes '25%'. The retired pack recorded 35% for
Punjab and said explicitly that the federal 25% did not apply. It does now.
3. FAMILY PENSION DURATION. Rule 4.10(1)-(6) substituted: a spouse's family pension runs
for TEN YEARS or until re-marriage, whichever comes first -- not for life. An issueless
spouse keeps it for life or until re-marriage. More than one widow: divided equally.
4. VOLUNTARY RETIREMENT. A reduction factor by age at retirement, new in this amendment.
5. ANNUAL INCREASE. Granted at 50% of the adhoc relief allowance for the financial year.
Nothing here changes the 7/300 accrual or the 30-year cap: the amendment restates both.

QS-01.description: Qualifying service runs from first regular entry to retirement, death, or notional superannuation.
QS-01.citation: Punjab Civil Services Pension Rules; BRAIN §9.1

QS-07.description: Fractions of a year: 6 months or more rounds up to a full year; less than 6 months is ignored.
QS-07.citation: Punjab Civil Services Pension Rules; BRAIN §9.1

QS-08.description: A maximum of 30 years is reckoned for pension, restated by the 2024 amendment's formula.

QS-10.description: Superannuation at age 60, taking effect on the afternoon of the day preceding the 60th birthday.
QS-10.citation: Punjab Civil Services Pension Rules; BRAIN §9.1

QS-16.description: Day-counting convention for qualifying service is EXCLUSIVE of the date of first entry.
QS-16.citation: BRAIN §9.1; convention fixed by this pack

EMOL-BASE.description: The pension base is the average BASIC PAY, INCLUDING PERSONAL PAY, over the last three years, reckoned from 1 July of each of the three years before retirement. Not last-drawn, and not the six-component reckonable pay.

EMOL-NOTE-1.description: Pay drawn in an autonomous or semi-autonomous body whose authorised capital is wholly subscribed by the Federal and/or a Provincial Government, in a post whose appointment and salary are fixed by Government, counts as pay drawn in Government service.

EMOL-NOTE-2.description: 'Pay' excludes pay drawn in Foreign Service and additional pay for performing the duties of another post.

CALC-01.description: Gross pension per month = average basic pay (EMOL-BASE) x length of service, capped at 30 years, x 7 / 300.

VOL-RED-01.description: On VOLUNTARY retirement the pension is reduced by a factor set by age at retirement: 59 years 2%, 58 years 4%, 57 years 6%, 56 years 8%, 55 years 10%. The amendment states no factor below 55 or above 59.

INC-01.description: The annual pension increase is granted at 50% of the adhoc relief allowance sanctioned for the respective financial year.

FAM-IS-01.description: On death in service the deceased's pay continues to the family until the notional superannuation date; family pension commences thereafter.

FAM-IS-03.description: Family pension = gross pension x 75/100 per month.
FAM-IS-03.citation: Punjab FD reformed pension procedure; BRAIN §9.7

FAM-IS-04.description: Gratuity on death in service. INTERPRETATION DISPUTED - two readings, no single figure.

FAM-IS-05.description: Family pension commences the day after the notional superannuation date.

FAM-DUR-01.description: A spouse's family pension runs for 10 years from commencement, or until re-marriage, whichever is earlier.

FAM-DUR-02.description: An ISSUELESS spouse receives family pension for life, or until re-marriage. The 10-year limit does not apply.
FAM-DUR-02.citation: FD notification 2 December 2024, rule 4.10(1) first proviso

FAM-DUR-03.description: Where the servant had more than one wife, the family pension is divided EQUALLY among the widows.
FAM-DUR-03.citation: FD notification 2 December 2024, rule 4.10(1) second proviso

ADD-02.description: Medical allowance: 25% of pension for BPS 1-15, 20% for BPS 16 and above. BASE DISPUTED.

ADD-03.description: Minimum pension and minimum family pension floors, per FD notification.
ADD-03.citation: Punjab FD notification - current values not loaded

COMM-01.description: Maximum commutation is 25% of gross pension. The 2024 amendment substituted '25%' for 'one half' in rule 8.1, superseding the 35% this engine previously applied for Punjab.

COMM-TABLE.description: Age factor by age next birthday. The loaded table is INCOMPLETE - four benchmark ages only.
COMM-TABLE.citation: Pension Rules / Compendium 2018 - full table not yet obtained

FMT-01.description: Monthly pension amounts round to the nearest whole rupee, half up.

EMOL-07.description: Orderly allowance. Whether it is reckonable was disputed under the pre-amendment base. The 2024 amendment narrows the base to basic pay including personal pay, which excludes it - but the amendment does not say so in terms, so the dispute is recorded rather than declared resolved.

_note_on_the_base: The 2024 amendment substituted rule 4.4(4) in full. The base is now an AVERAGE over
three years of two components, where it was a last-drawn figure over six.
The engine cannot compute this from a single pay slip. It needs the basic pay and
personal pay in force on 1 July in each of the three years before retirement, which
means three pay records, not one. Until the extraction supplies them, a determination
on this pack has to say so rather than substitute the last-drawn figure -- substituting
would overstate a pension for life on every rising pay scale.
_note_on_voluntary_retirement: The table states factors for ages 55 to 59 only. It says nothing about a voluntary
retirement below 55, and nothing about one at 60 or above -- at 60 superannuation
applies and no reduction arises. An age outside the table raises rather than
interpolating or defaulting to zero (BLOCKING-19): a missing factor is not a 0%
factor, and treating it as one would pay a full pension where a reduced one is due.

annual_increase._note: 50% of the adhoc relief allowance sanctioned for the respective financial year. The adhoc relief rates themselves are annual notifications and are not loaded (BLOCKING-20).

_blocking_21_pack_selection.question: Which date selects the rule pack for a death in service: the date of death, or the notional superannuation date on which the family pension commences?
_blocking_21_pack_selection.why_it_matters: The December 2024 amendment falls between the two on the reference case. Death 29-07-2021 selects the pre-amendment pack; notional superannuation 18-02-2026 selects the amended one, which narrows the base from six pay components to a three-year average of two. The same case computes differently depending on the answer.
_blocking_21_pack_selection.assumed_pending_a_ruling: The date of the event. A pension right crystallises when the servant dies or retires, and this engine will not apply an amendment made three years after a death unless told to.
